title: 第一卷第23章 狗眼看人低第一卷第24章 和气果的消息

君无邪一路马不停蹄奔向凤天城。
他心里很难受，很自责。
半年了，他竟对月瑶的病情半点不知。
她以前发病时，定是默默躲在他看不到的地方，一个人孤独地承受痛苦与煎熬！
“她很坚强。”神秘女子说道：“寒气彻骨，内脏却犹如烈火焚烧，她承受的痛苦，不比你在兵冢内承受的折磨小多少。”
“前辈，月瑶的身体到底是怎么回事，怎么会同时承受冰火之毒！”
君无邪无法想象，幼小的她是怎么熬过来的。
“前辈是说，这跟月瑶的血脉体质有关？”
“跟血脉体质无关，而是她缺失了一样东西。”
“缺失了什么东西？”
“别问了，你目前不需要知道这些。你现在要做的是得到和气果，然后在一月之内找到至少四星以上的医师为她医治，方能续命。”
君无邪没有再问，正如神秘女子说的，现在最重要的救治月瑶，其他的都不重要！
“让马车自己跑，你已到突破的极点，速速进来修炼，顺便疗伤。”
“好！”
君无邪再次进入永生神殿，服下小灵丹，一边疗伤，一边冲击境界。
他的伤势还没有恢复，如果就这样进入凤天城，绝非明智之举。
前后遭遇两批要杀他的人。
第一批是袁季派来的佣兵。
那第二批，身上没有煞气，而且境界很高，应该跟契克夫有关系。

凤天城，对于他来说绝非善地。
如果连自己的安全都保证不了，那还怎么救月瑶？
……
就在君无邪驾车狂奔向凤天城的时候，那座破庙里来了一群人。
为首的是契克夫与一名白面中年人。
看到熄灭的篝火旁那具女尸，中年人浑身颤抖，双目充血。
“晴儿！”
中年人声音干涩，略带哽咽，一掌将庙墙轰了个大洞！
“家主，节哀。”
一名面色苍白，缺了胳膊的老者上前劝慰。
“温海！”
中年猛地转身，双目赤红，一脚将断臂老者踹了出去。
这个该死的五长老，竟然抛弃他的女儿独自逃命！
“温岳家主，老夫为令媛的死表示遗憾。”契克夫说道：“为了弥补你们的损失，老夫许诺，只要你们杀掉君无邪，老夫额外给予你温家两枚大河海选令！”
“那君无邪，只是一个先天境武者，怎会这么强！”温岳强行压制心中的悲痛，道：“即便他是体剑双修，也应该不是温海的对手！”
“此人的确有过人之处，温海长老想必是大意了。”契克夫沉声说道：“现在，你们温家与他已经结下了仇，他若不死，将来必为你温家带来灾难。”
“他必死无疑！”五长老温海翻爬起来，看着自己的断臂，面部因仇恨而狰狞：“凤天城就是他的埋骨之地，我堂堂温家，在自己的地盘上碾死他，就如同碾死只蚂蚁！”
“很好，那老夫就等着你们的好消息。对了，记得割下他的人头送到老夫手里。”
契克夫说完转身离去，走出破庙之后，嘴角勾起一缕阴鸷的笑意。
“那萧旭本是天命使者，未来萧氏宗族的天命者知道自己的使者被人杀死，应该会震怒吧？老夫留着君无邪的人头，届时双手奉上，说不定可借此攀附上那天命者，飞黄腾达！”

契克夫心里打着自己的如意算盘，消失于夜色之中。

Jun Wuxie ran non-stop towards Fengtian City.
He felt very sad and blamed himself.
For half a year, he didn't know anything about Yueyao's condition.
When she got sick before, she must have hidden silently out of his sight, enduring the pain and suffering alone!
"She is very strong." The mysterious woman said: "The cold is to the bones, but the internal organs are like burning fire. The pain she endures is not much less than the torture you endured in the military tomb."
"Senior, what's going on with Yueyao's body? How can she bear the poison of ice and fire at the same time!"
Jun Wuxie couldn't imagine how she survived this at such a young age.
"Senior, are you saying that this has something to do with Yueyao's bloodline and constitution?"
"It has nothing to do with bloodline and constitution, but she is missing something."
"What's missing?"
"Don't ask, you don't need to know this right now. What you have to do now is to get the Peace Fruit, and then find a doctor with at least four stars to treat her within a month, so that you can live longer."
Jun Wuxie did not ask any more questions. Just as the mysterious woman said, the most important thing now is to save Yueyao, and nothing else is important!
"Let the carriage run by itself. You have reached the ultimate breakthrough point. Come in quickly to practice and heal your injuries."
"Okay!"
Jun Wuxie entered the Temple of Eternal Life again, took the Little Spiritual Pill, and healed his injuries while simultaneously reaching the realm.
He has not recovered from his injuries, so it would not be a wise move to enter Fengtian City like this.
He encountered two groups of people who wanted to kill him.
The first batch was the mercenaries sent by Yuan Ji.
The second group of people had no evil spirits and were at a very high level, so they should have something to do with Chekhov.
Fengtian City is definitely not a good place for him.
If you can't even guarantee your own safety, how can you save Yueyao?
…
Just as Jun Wuxie was driving towards Fengtian City, a group of people came from the ruined temple.
The leader was Chekhov and a white-faced middle-aged man.
Seeing the female corpse next to the extinguished bonfire, the middle-aged man trembled all over and his eyes were bloodshot.
"Qing'er!"
The middle-aged man's voice was dry and slightly choked, and he punched a big hole in the temple wall with one palm!
"Master, my condolences."
An old man with a pale face and missing arms stepped forward to comfort him.
"Wen Hai!"
The middle-aged man turned around suddenly, his eyes were red, and kicked the old man with a broken arm out.
This damn fifth elder actually abandoned his daughter and ran for his life alone!
"Head of the Wen Yue family, I express my regret for your daughter's death." Chekov said: "In order to make up for your losses, I promise that as long as you kill Jun Wuxie, I will give you two additional Dahe Sea Selection Orders from the Wen family!"
"That Jun Wuxie is just a Xiantian realm warrior, how could he be so strong!" Wen Yue suppressed the grief in his heart and said, "Even if he is a master of body and sword, he should not be Wen Hai's opponent!"
"This man is indeed extraordinary. Elder Wen Hai must have been careless." Chekhov said solemnly: "Now, your Wen family has become enemies with him. If he does not die, he will bring disaster to your Wen family in the future."
"He will definitely die!" The fifth elder Wen Hai got up and looked at his broken arm, his face was ferocious with hatred: "Fengtian City is his burial place. I, the Wen family, crush him to death on our own territory, just like crushing an ant to death!"
"Very good, then I will be waiting for your good news. By the way, remember to cut off his head and deliver it to me."
After speaking, Chekhov turned and left. After walking out of the ruined temple, a sinister smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
"Then Xiao Xu is the messenger of destiny. In the future, the destiny messenger of the Xiao clan will be furious when he knows that his messenger has been killed, right? I keep Jun Wuxie's head, and I will give it to him with both hands when the time comes. Maybe I can use it to get close to the destiny messenger and make a career!"
Chekhov disappeared into the night with his own wishful thinking in mind.
